dimensions.evidence: Five learning objectives map to U3-A1 through U3-A5 and U3-P1 through U3-P3.
Membrane, distributed source, volume conduction, interface and differential measurement remain distinct.
Rs, Rct, Cdl and half-cell potential are condition-specific and not universal constants.
Pattern, plausible mechanism, discriminating test and alternatives are required.
ECG, EEG and EMG comparison is technical and explicitly non-diagnostic.
No human acquisition, physical electrode connection, safety claim or conformity claim is authorized.
U3-A5 remains human-rubric only and complete answer keys are not exposed.
Preparation, blocker resolution, practices, assessments and prior audit are linked.

minor.finding: Professional review must verify terminology around electrode-electrolyte interface and functional node taxonomy before release.
A human reviewer must score U3-A5 with the supplied rubric before claiming assessment validation.
